paragraphs.text: You mention the residency you will be taking up at St. Mary’s Hospital. The institution is well regarded, and you are both thrilled and slightly uneasy at the range of patients and maladies it receives. Still, as an old professor of yours used to say, “By practice alone can you become expert.”
“A doctor, eh? Folks’ll always be needing those.” Did you catch a note of distrust in Silas’s voice? Or are you just being paranoid?

Your Occupation Skills are: First Aid, Other Language (Latin), Medicine, Psychology, Science (Biology), Science (Pharmacy) You may also pick two other skills (not Cthulhu Mythos) as relevant academic or personal specialties. Allocate the following values among these Occupation Skills, writing in the large square beside each: 70%, 60%, 60%, 50%, 50%, 50%, 40%, 40%. Ignore any starting value already mentioned on the investigator sheet.
